privacy.data_collected_body: Provided you sign up for an account, we store your email address and the books you scan: ISBN, title, author, cover image URL, and reading status. No other personal data is collected.
privacy.storage_body: Your data is stored in Cloudflare D1, hosted across Cloudflare's global network. Passwords are never stored in plaintext.
privacy.third_parties_body: Book metadata is fetched from Wikidata, Google Books API and OpenLibrary using the provided ISBN. No other identifying information is sent to these services.
privacy.retention_body: Your data is retained for as long as your account exists. Deleting a book removes it immediately. Account deletion removes all associated data.
